projects.title: CampGPT-X: LLM Training and Campus Intelligent Q&A
projects.summary:
LLM systems, intelligent Q&A
Project Summary: Built a 2B-parameter decoder-only MoE large language model following the complete Pretraining → SFT → DPO pipeline, adapting a general language model to the campus Q&A domain; completed distributed training and inference optimization on a 4×A800 cluster and finally deployed a campus intelligent Q&A system.
Model Architecture & Pre-training: Implemented a GPT-like architecture (RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU, GQA) with 8-expert top-2 routing plus shared experts, mitigating expert collapse through load balancing; completed 100B-token pre-training, with validation PPL dropping from 38 to 17 and stable convergence.
Data Pipeline Construction: Built domain data construction pipelines for the SFT/DPO stages, designing an automated "model generation + rule filtering" Pipeline that filters low-quality samples with relevance and consistency rules, reaching an 88% valid-sample ratio; finally built 10k instruction samples and 10k preference samples.
Instruction Tuning & Alignment: Performed full-parameter SFT for domain adaptation, raising answer accuracy on the campus Q&A evaluation set from about 5% to 75%; further DPO preference optimization raised the pairwise win rate by about 15% and significantly reduced hallucinations.
Training & Inference Optimization: Targeting memory and compute bottlenecks, used FSDP (ZeRO-2) for gradient and optimizer-state sharding during training, combined with Gradient Checkpointing and FlashAttention-2 to optimize memory and compute efficiency, reducing overall memory usage by 32% and increasing training throughput about 6×; at inference, reduced KV Cache overhead through GQA, cutting inference latency by about 40% and increasing throughput by about 60%.

projects.title: Aero-Engine Damage Intelligent Detection and Deployment
projects.summary:
Industrial damage recognition
Project Summary: Facing scarce aero-engine borescope image data and inefficient manual inspection, implemented damage recognition and terminal-device deployment based on YOLOv9.
Core Work: Responsible for borescope image annotation and data construction; expanded the sample size with a multi-region stitching Mixup method, then completed model fine-tuning and training-pipeline setup with transfer learning, finally achieving edge deployment (ONNX/TensorRT) to support inspection on embedded devices.

Text-Routed Mixture-of-Experts Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
research.summary:
Video sentiment analysis, temporal modeling, explainability
Project Summary: To address the core problems in multimodal sentiment analysis that "text is dominant but under-utilized" and "audio-visual temporal information is hard to align", proposed a unified framework of "explanation-driven alignment + temporal modeling + text-routed mixture of experts", enhancing model interpretability while improving performance.
Explanation-driven Alignment: Introduced an MLLM to generate emotional explanations of the audio and video modalities as an intermediate semantic bridge, mitigating cross-modal semantic inconsistency.
Temporal Alignment Modeling: Designed Temporal Alignment to effectively model long- and short-term dependencies and synchronization between audio and video while keeping linear complexity.
Text-Routed MoE: Proposed using text semantics as the routing signal to select expert networks, reinforcing the "text-dominant" property and reducing interference from ineffective modalities.
Experimental Results: Outperformed existing methods on MOSI, MOSEI, CH-SIMS and other datasets; MAE on CH-SIMS dropped to 0.353 (↓13.5%).

research.title: Multimodal Emotion Reasoning and Explanation Generation
research.summary:
Multimodal video understanding, emotion reasoning
Project Summary: To address scarce annotation data in multimodal emotion recognition and the loss of temporal emotional information during LLM tokenization, proposed a unified "data augmentation + temporal pre-fusion" framework, achieving cross-modal emotion reasoning and natural-language explanation generation and significantly improving emotional consistency and interpretability.
Multimodal Emotion Reasoning Data: Used AffectGPT fine-tuned on OV-MERD to generate reasoning-style emotion descriptions for SIMSv2; after Qwen3 consistency filtering and manual correction, built 4,403 high-quality emotion reasoning samples, effectively mitigating annotation scarcity and improving human-like reasoning ability.
Mamba Temporal pre-Fusion: Before entering the LLM, performed cross-modal pre-fusion of audio and visual frame sequences, using SSM to model long-range temporal dependencies with linear complexity, then generated gating signals via Conv1d+SiLU to achieve bidirectional audio↔visual interaction through element-wise modulation; the fused features are projected into a unified multimodal representation that preserves temporal information, avoiding the loss of temporal dynamics and cross-modal synchronization caused by independent tokenization.
Multimodal Prompt Reasoning: Built a structured Prompt combining fusion tokens, unimodal global tokens and subtitles, guiding Qwen2.5-7B to generate natural-language explanations with emotional reasoning chains. In the competition's official human evaluation, ranked 3rd overall on the authenticity and fluency of the generated explanations.
